final_message:
Configured DNS for all 60 PCs using pc1 as the lab’s DNS server. The configuration includes the 27 requested host addresses and four MX records, including their mail-server addresses. The existing network connections and routing were left unchanged.

I checked the zone files and startup-script syntax. I could not run a live DNS test because Kathara and BIND validation tools were unavailable in this environment. The setup also depends on `named` being present in the Kathara base image.

The DNS server is authoritative for the configured domains, so other existing names beneath those domains would need records in these zones to remain resolvable.
